<h1>Meshery v0.7.167</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.167">Released</a> on December 03, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert \Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.45 to 0.17.57\ @leecalcote (#12828)</li>
<li>add trim option to GetMesheryPatterns for response customization @amitamrutiya (#12799)</li>
<li>enrich logs for subscribe w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#12796)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump humanize-duration from 3.31.0 to 3.32.1 in /ui @dependabot (#12811)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.13.0 to 11.13.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12819)</li>
<li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.126 @l5io (#12827)</li>
<li>Revert \Revert \Improvement in errorBoundary\ @sudhanshutech (#12782)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 15.0.2 to 15.0.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12818)</li>
<li>[MeshModelComponent] fix: Generate Model radio button colors. @apoorvapendse (#12803)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.13.3 to 11.13.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12822)</li>
<li>Bump xstate from 5.18.2 to 5.19.0 in /ui @dependabot (#12810)</li>
<li>test: fix local provider connection body and re enabled performance test @jerensl (#12797)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/text from 0.19.0 to 0.20.0 @dependabot (#12817)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.17.45 to 0.17.57 @dependabot (#12815)</li>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/sync from 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 @dependabot (#12816)</li>
<li>Bump humanize-duration from 3.31.0 to 3.32.1 in /ui @dependabot (#12811)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.13.0 to 11.13.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12819)</li>
<li>[Chore] Readme updated @SAHU-01 (#12823)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 15.0.2 to 15.0.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12818)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.13.3 to 11.13.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12822)</li>
<li>Bump xstate from 5.18.2 to 5.19.0 in /ui @dependabot (#12810)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump rails-html-sanitizer from 1.6.0 to 1.6.1 in /docs @dependabot (#12825)</li>
<li>Added in documentation to use a valid uuid for &ndash;orgId @pranjalg1331 (#12643)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.168</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.168">Released</a> on December 09, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Meshsync apis and extension enhancements @aabidsofi19 (#12807)</li>
<li>mesheryctl: add filter for not publishing to meshery relationship @jerensl (#12826)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>test: fix some connection and performance test @jerensl (#12860)</li>
<li>Meshsync apis and extension enhancements @aabidsofi19 (#12807)</li>
<li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.128 @l5io (#12839)</li>
<li>[MesherySettings]: Add new tab for overview in settings. @apoorvapendse (#12836)</li>
<li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.127 @l5io (#12838)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Delete .editorconfig @Ajay-singh1 (#12859)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.17</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.17">Released</a> on February 09, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Meshmodel] Update pod,replicaset,job,cronjob to have genealogy parent @aabidsofi19 (#10248)</li>
<li>updated pencil node @captain-Akshay (#10225)</li>
<li>add: Relationship between Event component and other k8s components @RipulHandoo (#10194)</li>
<li>change log severity to debug @MUzairS15 (#10221)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix pattern apply @theBeginner86 (#10142)</li>
<li>Fix golangci-lint issues in mesheryctl. @gyohuangxin (#10226)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix icon color @sudhanshutech (#10245)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.170</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.170">Released</a> on December 16, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">

</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>update operator routes @aabidsofi19 (#12897)</li>
<li>v0.9.0 Roadmap Refinement @leecalcote (#12871)</li>
<li>Refactor NGINX configuration: separate playground settings into a new file and add CORS support @leecalcote (#12848)</li>
<li>Bump path-to-regexp and express in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#12874)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.3.7 to 3.3.8 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#12873)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">

</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.130 @l5io (#12898)</li>
<li>use sistent visibanglagnlilty chip and remove the static image  @amitamrutiya (#12896)</li>
<li>Bump node-polyfill-webpack-plugin from 2.0.1 to 4.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#12812)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.3.7 to 3.3.8 in /ui @dependabot (#12875)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.3.6 to 3.3.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12876)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>bump -snapshot action @aabidsofi19 (#12895)</li>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/crypto from 0.27.0 to 0.31.0 @dependabot (#12872)</li>
<li>Bump node-polyfill-webpack-plugin from 2.0.1 to 4.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#12812)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.3.7 to 3.3.8 in /ui @dependabot (#12875)</li>
<li>Bump nanoid from 3.3.6 to 3.3.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#12876)</li>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {

                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.171</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.171">Released</a> on December 18, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>remove asset deduplication for component/model svgs @aabidsofi19 (#12912)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>updated locators within indexui.spec.js file @moiz2405 (#12365)</li>
<li>make performance tests compatible with use in extensions @aabidsofi19 (#12911)</li>
<li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.131 @l5io (#12907)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>docs: improve contributing to playwright e2e test @jerensl (#12866)</li>
<li>Accordion view for test results @SAHU-01 (#12908)</li>
<li>Adding a table to display relationship test Results @SAHU-01 (#12853)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.19</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.19">Released</a> on February 14, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Fix connection <code>status</code> getting overriden during import of K8s connection. @MUzairS15 (#10303)</li>
<li>Ripul handoo/relationships/pod template @RipulHandoo (#10271)</li>
<li>add: Relationship between Replication Controller and other k8s resources @RipulHandoo (#10274)</li>
<li>add: relationship between k8s lease and other k8s components[high-level] @RipulHandoo (#10244)</li>
<li>run component updater @MUzairS15 (#10286)</li>
<li>feat: Relationship between HPA and other k8s components. @RipulHandoo (#10126)</li>
<li>add: Relationship between csi-driver and other k8s resources @RipulHandoo (#10262)</li>
<li>feat: relationship between kubernetes secret and other resources @RipulHandoo (#9880)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix conflicts @MUzairS15 (#10285)</li>
<li>Feature/exp components command @RipulHandoo (#9726)</li>
<li>[Meshmodel] Update Components  @aabidsofi19 (#10277)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[fix] remove xstate/inspect @aabidsofi19 (#10302)</li>
<li>fix hover of hyperlink @sudhanshutech (#10288)</li>
<li>[Meshmodel] Update Components  @aabidsofi19 (#10277)</li>
<li>Fix the React Warnings in Meshery UI Build @MeenuyD (#10266)</li>
<li>Testing small change  @sudhanshutech (#10265)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/onsi/ginkgo/v2 from 2.13.1 to 2.15.0 @dependabot (#10148)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Relationships and Policies @MUzairS15 (#10253)</li>
<li>Fixed text color in swagger layout @iArchitSharma (#10279)</li>
<li>error table liquid fix @iArchitSharma (#10283)</li>
<li>Reference added to error table @iArchitSharma (#10281)</li>
<li>[Docs] Remove deprecated adapters from toc sidebar @leecalcote (#10257)</li>
<li>[Docs] Enhance enhanced layout with optional suggested-reading list @leecalcote (#10256)</li>
<li>Fix missing list @iArchitSharma (#10260)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@MUzairS15, @MeenuyD, @RipulHandoo, @aabidsofi19, @dependabot, @iArchitSharma, @l5io, @leecalcote, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.2-rc-2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.2-rc-2">Released</a> on December 15, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Connection to Environments Mapping @theBeginner86 (#9632)</li>
<li>update cred def to handle oneOF properly @MUzairS15 (#9631)</li>
<li>[Draft] v0.8.0 Roadmap @leecalcote (#9146)</li>
<li>add grafana to config @MUzairS15 (#9628)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix: #9399 Changed hovering effect @Raj100679 (#9444)</li>
<li>[ui] Add react markdown @aabidsofi19 (#9640)</li>
<li>Fix: Added Responsive Style for Dashboard charts. Signed-off-by Danan… @Dananjay996 (#9622)</li>
<li>[Spaces] Finalize support for Environments @theBeginner86 (#9618)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Fix Environment Payload @theBeginner86 (#9636)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Fix Environment Payload @theBeginner86 (#9636)</li>
<li>[DOCS]: removed extra full stop @AdarshRawat1 (#9634)</li>
<li>Docs: Update functional categories @leecalcote (#9633)</li>
<li>[Spaces] Finalize support for Environments @theBeginner86 (#9618)</li>
<li>Access slides and resources link updated @abhijeetgauravm (#9624)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.7.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.2">Released</a> on December 19, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix env component @theBeginner86 (#9659)</li>
<li>[server][meshmodel] chore: add aws controllers @VihasMakwana (#9650)</li>
<li>[Model] AWS EKS: Model and Component metadata @leecalcote (#9649)</li>
<li>chore: add aws eks controller statically @VihasMakwana (#9638)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Environments] Environments page @senali-d (#9647)</li>
<li>[UI] Correct indicators for context switcher. @MUzairS15 (#9645)</li>
<li>Upgrade Performance table to sistent table @sudhanshutech (#9648)</li>
<li>update mdeditor @aabidsofi19 (#9646)</li>
<li>[UI] - Prompt Component button color @senali-d (#9644)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>chore(build-and-release-stable): ignore rc releases @chenrui333 (#9642)</li>
<li>chore(ci/cd): Update e2e tests with newer k8s versions @webstradev (#9665)</li>
<li>[environments] Add API to Get Connections for Environment @theBeginner86 (#9651)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[environments] Add API to Get Connections for Environment @theBeginner86 (#9651)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
